hypothesis: Intermediate distance labels alone do not teach candidate ranking toward intermediate goals; linked seven-step landmark stars may help bridge long restoration paths.
comparison: Same completed checkpoint, restored Adam, identical base batches and fixed update count for control versus landmark supervision. Independent landmark RNG does not perturb base batches. Primary last checkpoint; no test selection.
split: Retain original heldout state mask; reject a whole landmark star if parent, target or any candidate is held out. Test roots never supply training labels. Seven-step bank sampled from training states only, frozen before updates.
inference: Report direct restoration plus a separately labeled waypoint policy: choose nearest Q landmark from a fixed training bank, greedily target it, then solved after exact landmark arrival; never use oracle routing. Oracle-provided shortest-path landmarks are an explicitly separate diagnostic upper bound, never a main policy.
scope: Cheap matched local feasibility probe, not replacement of the running 100-epoch jobs or a claim that all ten-step states are covered by a small landmark bank. No learned V, extra head, fixed coordinate answers, search or retrieval of recorded solutions. Runtime records remain outside Git.
